site: Any (Datadog audit run with FORM_ANSWER_MODE=profile and no writer key)
class: A __getattr__ raised a non-AttributeError for an optional attribute, so hasattr/getattr-with-default crashed instead of answering 'absent'
symptom: The run stopped before the browser opened, with 'no writer has a key in Settings' -- although the run promises to attach the owner's own resume when no writer is set.
root_cause: apply_flow asks hasattr(claude, 'cost_summary'). Brain sends that name to Writers, whose __getattr__ raised ClaudeIntegrationError (a RuntimeError) for every name when no writer existed; hasattr only swallows AttributeError.
why_tests_missed: Writers was tested for writing documents with and without writers, never probed for an attribute it does not have.
fix: With no writer, Writers.__getattr__ raises AttributeError for any name that is not a document; asking for tailor_resume/generate_cover_letter still raises ClaudeIntegrationError with the reason.
prevention: A proxy's __getattr__ raises AttributeError for anything it does not provide; a domain error is raised only when a provided capability is used.
